description: Net cost of buying new, buying used, renting, and digital for a textbook. Purchase options are reduced by the resale value (floored at zero), and the cheapest option is returned. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive Textbook Cost calculator.

buy_new_price.description: Price to buy the book new in USD.

buy_used_price.description: Price to buy the book used in USD.

resale_value.description: Expected resale value after the term in USD.

name: calculate_textbook_cost
